statement: Let H=M_3(C_3) be the 13-vertex graph defined in problem.md, and play the standard proper vertex-coloring game with Alice moving first and a common set of four colors. Alice has a winning strategy from the empty position. Moreover H is not three-colorable by the forced-layer argument in evidence/research.md; consequently the game chromatic number is chi_g(M_3(C_3))=4. This statement is only for the layer parameter k=3.
contribution: An exact computer-assisted resolution of the frozen finite problem. A complete deterministic Alice-strategy DAG is supplied and independently replayed with graph reconstruction, legal-move and terminal checks, exhaustive raw Bob branching, direct color-permutation canonicalization, independently enumerated graph automorphisms, and backward induction. This does not assert a result for other layer parameters or claim that the source authors explicitly posed the k=3 instance as open.
